prediction.rationale: LSEG "equity research estimates" (I/B/E/S, sell-side equity research estimates) maps to CDAO EquityResearch. The authoritative node (cdao-ab) is defined as "Sell-side and independent analyst research on listed equities" with synonyms including "sell-side research" and "estimates" — a direct definitional match to the vendor assertion. Runner-up candidates were ruled out on the confirmed graph: Pricing = "market price observations" and ReferenceData = "static reference data / symbology", neither of which describe analyst estimates. An existing LSEG I/B/E/S-family mapping (mds.lseg:9e420bc7…) targets EquityResearch at 0.88, corroborating placement. Note a cross-vendor conflict: S&P (SPG-EQRES-77) maps a similar product to NewsAndResearch, but that node is "newswires and qualitative research artifacts" (transcripts/news), whereas I/B/E/S estimates are structured quantitative consensus data — so EquityResearch remains the better-supported target for this product. The conflict reflects a genuine taxonomy-organisation disagreement, so I flag it for human awareness while auto-publishing above the 0.80 floor.
